unverified.years: Zeta/Zetec family 1991 - Dec 2004 (Wikipedia; final Zeta-Zetec built Dec 10, 2004 at Bridgend). North American 2.0 applications: Contour/Mystique 1995-2000, Escort ZX2 1998-2003, Cougar 1999-2002, Focus 2000-2004, Escape/Tribute 2001-2004 (Wikipedia); Engine Builder (2008) lists Focus/Escape 2000-2003; Ford Engine History says developed for the 1994 Mondeo/Contour. Start/end years not confirmed by 3 agreeing sources. Cougar use 1999-2002 is confirmed (Wikipedia, Consumer Guide, EPA, Engine Builder).
